comparisons.name: empty-light
comparisons.description: An empty well, and one pinned as a drop target (the runner cannot perform a drag, so that one uses data-force). Aqua.

pixels.note: the 2 pt ring (spec: Ring, measured)
the recess alone, black at 4% over #ececec (alpha measured: #dadada over #e3e3e3); that an empty well shows only the recess is inferred (spec: States, empty)
hairline outside the ring, black at 6.2% over #ececec (alpha measured: #d5d5d5 over #e3e3e3)
drop target: the blue accent over the ring (spec: States, drag target highlight, inferred)
the recess of the drop target is unchanged

comparisons.name: empty-dark

the recess, white at 4% over #2f3032 (alpha measured: #3e3e3f over #363637)
drop target: the blue accent (inferred)

comparisons.name: drop-target-purple-inactive
comparisons.description: The drop target with the purple accent in an inactive window: the highlight follows the accent and stays, because a drag from another application arrives while this window is not key. Aqua.

pixels.note: the purple accent (accent table, measured swatch); that the highlight takes it is inferred

comparisons.name: drop-target-purple-inactive-dark
comparisons.description: The drop target with the purple accent in an inactive window, Dark Aqua: the highlight follows the accent and stays.

pixels.note: the purple accent of Dark Aqua (accent table, measured swatch of Theme-Dark-Purple); that the highlight takes it is inferred
the recess of the drop target is unchanged: white at 4% over #2f3032 (alpha measured: #3e3e3f over #363637)
